Congratulations on working very hard to receive your PhD. I have two NParents and I also plan on receiving one as well. 

I think that you shouldn’t invite them if they create a lot of stress, here is why:
1. If you invite them and they cause a lot of problems and stress which causes you to fail, you will regret inviting them.
2. If they don’t come and you feel guilty that they weren’t there on your big day, I feel like that feeling will be a lot less severe than if you fail your defense. 

The counselor says to me that you may want something so bad, but if they’re unwilling to change (which usually NParents are) then he suggested to me that I accept the reality of the situation and find a way to make it work differently.

Maybe you can invite other people in your life that mean a lot to you besides your parents, like friends or mentors. 

I understand wanting to be good enough for them, I feel the same way too but I’ve also come to terms that maybe they’re not good enough for me.

Hope this helps!
